464832.overview: Hunting. Automaton. Beasts. Hunt down giant beasts through a fantasy world inspired by feudal Japan. Craft a wide variety of "Karakuri" (Automaton) to assist in hunting and skilfully wield uniquely crafted weapons to cut these creatures down to size. Now supports up to four players on the Nintendo Switch 2 system! Enjoy hunting in various styles.
